cards.name: DLN / lean premix
lowers: NOx: keeps the premix-zone flame temperature low and uniform
raises: CO, and the risk of flame instability when the flame temperature drops at part load
cards.efficiency: Adds no fuel use directly. The limit is the load range you can run at low emissions.
operation: Needs a fuel-split and IGV schedule that follows load (OEM schedule, not modeled)
The usable load range needs unit data

cards.name: Lean-burn
lowers: NOx: a lean, homogeneous mixture lowers the flame temperature
cards.efficiency: Efficiency stays good at high load. Methane slip eats into the CO₂e advantage (see Scene 8).
operation: The size of the methane slip needs unit data

cards.name: EGR (exhaust gas recirculation)
lowers: NOx: recirculated exhaust lowers the peak burned-zone temperature
raises: Thermal load on the EGR cooler
cards.efficiency: A small to moderate efficiency penalty. The size needs unit data.
operation: Needs an EGR cooler and control of the recirculation rate

cards.name: Water / steam injection
lowers: NOx: water or steam absorbs heat and lowers the flame temperature
cards.efficiency: Power output can rise, but efficiency usually drops. The size needs unit data.
operation: Needs a demineralized water supply and treatment
The water-to-fuel ratio must be kept in range

cards.name: SCR (selective catalytic reduction)
lowers: NOx in the exhaust, after combustion. Breaks the trade-off with the combustor
raises: Ammonia slip if the dose is wrong
cards.efficiency: A small η penalty from backpressure. The size needs unit or supplier data.
operation: Needs an exhaust temperature window; the values come from unit data
Needs a reductant (ammonia or urea), installation space, and a dosing system

cards.name: Oxidation catalyst
lowers: CO and VOC in the exhaust
cards.efficiency: A small η penalty from backpressure. The size needs unit data.
operation: Needs an exhaust temperature window; the values come from unit data
The catalyst is sensitive to fuel and lube-oil contaminants

cards.name: DPF (diesel particulate filter)
raises: Exhaust backpressure, which grows as the filter loads up
cards.efficiency: A small η penalty that grows during regeneration. The size needs unit data.
